name: Caustic Sludge
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, unchained summoner 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft. radius spread
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Foul caustic sludge seeps up from the ground in the designated area. This sludge is deep and sticky causing the area to be difficult terrain unless the target can fly or hover over the ground. Additionally, a creature takes 1d6 acid damage for every 5 feet moved through the area. If the target ends their turn without moving while in the area, they take 1d6 acid damage.
